explication: This repository is a collection of independent Transformers.js examples, not one application with a shared runtime. The typical browser demo lets a user provide text, an image, or audio, runs an inference task in a worker or app, and presents the result; the Node.js and framework examples demonstrate other ways to host inference. The map groups the major documented capabilities and notable example families. Many implementations were not sampled, so uncertain internal links are omitted rather than inferred from filenames.
